get_coin.description: Get a coin's profile from CoinGecko: what it is, its links, categories and contract addresses, and its market data in every currency, optionally with its top 100 trading pairs.

description.en: Bitcoin is the world's first decentralized cryptocurrency, created in 2009 by the pseudonymous Satoshi Nakamoto.

get_coin.name: get_coin

parameters.description: The coin's CoinGecko ID (for example, bitcoin or ethereum). IDs are CoinGecko's own names, not ticker symbols: use Search CoinGecko to find a coin's ID from its name or symbol.
parameters.name: coin_id

parameters.description: Leave on to include prices and market figures; turn off for the profile alone.
parameters.name: include_market_data

parameters.description: Set to true to include the coin's top 100 trading pairs.
parameters.name: include_tickers

asset_platform_id.description: The platform a token is issued on, or null for a coin with its own chain.

block_time_in_minutes.description: The chain's block time in minutes, where it has one.

categories.description: The categories CoinGecko files the coin under.

country_origin.description: The country the project comes from, if known.

description.description: What the coin is, in English, under en.

detail_platforms.description: The same, with each contract's decimal places.

genesis_date.description: The date the coin launched, if known.

hashing_algorithm.description: The chain's hashing algorithm, where it has one.

image.description: Links to the coin's logo: thumb, small and large.

last_updated.description: When the figures were last updated (ISO 8601).

links.description: The coin's homepage, whitepaper, block explorers, forums, social accounts and source code.

market_cap_rank.description: The coin's rank by market cap.

market_data.description: Prices and market figures, or null when Include market data is off.

ath.description: The all-time high in each currency.

ath_date.description: When the all-time high was reached, per currency (ISO 8601).

atl.description: The all-time low in each currency.

atl_date.description: When the all-time low was reached, per currency (ISO 8601).

circulating_supply.description: How many coins are in circulation.

fully_diluted_valuation.description: The fully diluted valuation in each currency.

high_24h.description: The 24 hour high in each currency.

last_updated.description: When the figures were last updated (ISO 8601).

low_24h.description: The 24 hour low in each currency.

market_cap.description: The market cap in each currency.

market_cap_rank.description: The coin's rank by market cap.

max_supply.description: The most coins there can ever be, or null if there is no cap.

price_change_percentage_1y.description: The price change over 1 year, as a percentage.

price_change_percentage_24h.description: The price change over 24 hours, as a percentage, in US dollars.

price_change_percentage_30d.description: The price change over 30 days, as a percentage.

price_change_percentage_7d.description: The price change over 7 days, as a percentage.

total_volume.description: The 24 hour trading volume in each currency.

platforms.description: The token's contract address on each platform it is issued on.

public_notice.description: A notice CoinGecko shows on the coin's page, if any.

sentiment_votes_down_percentage.description: The share who voted it down, as a percentage.

sentiment_votes_up_percentage.description: The share of CoinGecko users who voted the coin up, as a percentage.

symbol.description: The coin's ticker symbol, in lowercase.

tickers.description: The coin's top 100 trading pairs, or empty unless Include tickers is on.

bid_ask_spread_percentage.description: The gap between the best bid and ask, as a percentage.

coin_mcap_usd.description: The base coin's market cap in US dollars.

converted_last.description: The last price in btc, eth and usd.

converted_volume.description: The 24 hour volume in btc, eth and usd.

is_anomaly.description: True when CoinGecko flags the price.

is_stale.description: True when the price has stopped updating.

last.description: The last traded price, in the target.

last_fetch_at.description: When CoinGecko last fetched the pair (ISO 8601).

market.description: The exchange: its name and CoinGecko identifier.

target_coin_id.description: The target coin's CoinGecko ID, when it is a coin.

token_info_url.description: A link to the token's details.

trade_url.description: A link to trade the pair.

trust_score.description: CoinGecko's trust rating for the pair, or null where it gives none.

volume.description: The 24 hour volume, in the base.

watchlist_portfolio_users.description: How many CoinGecko users watch the coin.

get_coin_history.description: Get a coin's price, market cap and 24 hour volume in every currency CoinGecko supports, as they stood at 00:00 UTC on a date in the past 365 days.
get_coin_history.display_name: Get coin data on a date
get_coin_history.name: get_coin_history

get_market_chart.description: Get a coin's price, market cap and trading volume over the past 1 to 365 days, as series of points you can chart or summarize.
